detailed_description: JSONL Validator checks JSON Lines and NDJSON-style input one line at a time. Paste log events, model batch records, export rows, or streaming payload examples, and the tool reports how many lines parse successfully plus the exact line numbers that fail. Valid rows are normalized into compact JSONL so developers can copy a clean sample into tests, ingestion scripts, or debugging notes.

Review the calculated or generated result
